idea-plugin.name: MASMLD Core
idea-plugin.description:
Modular assembly language infrastructure for IntelliJ Platform IDEs, with RustRover as the primary tested product.

  • Shared .asm, .s and .S file types and file icons.
  • Per-project architecture selection and an extensible architecture registry.
  • Install MASMLD RISC-V for highlighting, offline documentation and navigation, or MASMLD GNU Linker Script for .ld support.

Core provides generic assembly support on its own. Optional modules are distributed separately. Restart after installing or changing modules; keep all MASMLD modules on the same version.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.7.0: First public release under the MIT license. Adds blue/purple modular cube branding and navigation from same-file macro calls and .purgem to .macro definitions. Includes assembly and linker-script highlighting, offline documentation, file icons and host source-symbol navigation.
